text:
Osaka's biggest Christmas market is free to walk into, and it's not in Umeda or Namba 🎄

It fills the lawn at Tennoji Park: 24 shops, three giant trees and a tunnel of lights lined up so Abeno Harukas glows right behind it. Open until 25 December.

Glühwein in the park or hot chocolate under the lights? ☕
